import torch, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_149")
import kernel as K

# all finite FP16 encodings (exclude NaN/Inf: exponent all ones)
codes = [c for c in range(0x10000) if (c & 0x7C00) != 0x7C00]
x = torch.tensor(codes, dtype=torch.int16).view(torch.float16).cuda().contiguous()
assert x.numel() == 15361
out = K.run(x)
ref = K.reference(x)
ob = out.view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().astype(int)
rb = ref.view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().astype(int)
mism = (ob != rb)
nm = int(mism.sum())
examples = []
for i in torch.nonzero(torch.from_numpy(mism)).flatten().tolist()[:10]:
    examples.append({"x_bits": codes[i], "x": float(torch.tensor(codes[i], dtype=torch.int16).view(torch.float16)),
                     "got_bits": int(ob[i]) & 0xFFFF, "ref_bits": int(rb[i]) & 0xFFFF})
print(json.dumps({"claim": "c1 exhaustive sweep over all 15361 finite FP16 encodings",
                  "metric": "exact FP16 bit-pattern equality vs reference() oracle (count of mismatching elements)",
                  "n": 15361, "mismatch_count": nm, "examples": examples,
                  "verdict_supports_bug": nm > 0}))
", "expected_signal": "nonzero mismatch count if the FP32 internal arithmetic flips an FP16 rounding tie; zero mismatches rebuts c1"}

import torch, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_149")
import kernel as K

# negative inputs only, covering subnormal-output range ~[-24,-8] and beyond to -65504
codes = [c for c in range(0x10000) if (c & 0x7C00) != 0x7C00]
neg = torch.tensor(codes, dtype=torch.int16).view(torch.float16)
neg = neg[neg < 0]
x = neg.cuda().contiguous()
out = K.run(x)
ref = K.reference(x)
ob = out.view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().astype(int) & 0xFFFF
rb = ref.view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().astype(int) & 0xFFFF
xb = x.view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().astype(int) & 0xFFFF
mism = (ob != rb)
nm = int(mism.sum())
sub_mask = ((rb != 0) & ((rb & 0x7C00) == 0))  # reference output is positive FP16 subnormal
n_sub = int(sub_mask.sum())
sub_mism = int((mism & sub_mask).sum())
examples = []
idxs = torch.nonzero(torch.from_numpy(mism & sub_mask)).flatten().tolist()[:10]
for i in idxs:
    examples.append({"x_bits": xb[i], "got_bits": ob[i], "ref_bits": rb[i]})
# also count outputs that reference maps to +0 vs kernel maps to +0
zero_ref = int((rb == 0).sum()); zero_got = int((ob == 0).sum())
print(json.dumps({"claim": "c2 subnormal-output focus (all negative finite FP16 inputs)",
                  "metric": "exact FP16 bit-pattern equality vs reference for subnormal-reference outputs; FP16 subnormal step = 2^-24",
                  "n_negative_inputs": int(x.numel()), "mismatch_count_all": nm,
                  "n_ref_subnormal_outputs": n_sub, "mismatch_subnormal": sub_mism,
                  "examples": examples, "zero_ref_count": zero_ref, "zero_got_count": zero_got,
                  "verdict_supports_bug": sub_mism > 0}))
", "expected_signal": "subnormal-output bit mismatches (incl. wrong +0 vs smallest subnormal) confirm c2; exact subnormal equality rebuts"}

import torch, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_149")
import kernel as K

bits = lambda t: (t.view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().astype(int) & 0xFFFF).tolist()
# signed zeros
z = torch.tensor([0.0, -0.0], dtype=torch.float16).cuda()
oz, rz = K.run(z), K.reference(z)
# strongly negative inputs where sigmoid underflows to +0 (x <= -19 gives sigmoid < 3e-9 << 2^-25)
neg_bits = list(range(0xF900, 0x10000))  # covers -352 to -65504 region? compute properly below
codes = [c for c in range(0x8000, 0x10000) if (c & 0x7C00) != 0x7C00]
xn = torch.tensor(codes, dtype=torch.int16).view(torch.float16).cuda().contiguous()
on, rn = K.run(xn), K.reference(xn)
obn, rbn = bits(on), bits(rn)
neg_mism = sum(1 for a, b in zip(obn, rbn) if a != b)
neg_zero_got = sum(1 for a in obn if a == 0)
neg_zero_ref = sum(1 for b in rbn if b == 0)
neg_negzero_got = sum(1 for a in obn if a == 0x8000)
neg_negzero_ref = sum(1 for b in rbn if b == 0x8000)
print(json.dumps({"claim": "c3 signed-zero and underflow-to-zero bit patterns",
                  "metric": "exact FP16 output bit patterns: +0 = 0x0000, -0 = 0x8000, sigmoid(0)=sigmoid(-0)=0.5 (0x3800)",
                  "in_0_bits": bits(oz), "ref_0_bits": bits(rz),
                  "n_negative_inputs": len(codes), "negative_mismatch_count": neg_mism,
                  "neg_zero_got": neg_zero_got, "neg_zero_ref": neg_zero_ref,
                  "neg_negzero_got": neg_negzero_got, "neg_negzero_ref": neg_negzero_ref,
                  "verdict_supports_bug": (bits(oz) != bits(rz)) or neg_zero_got != neg_zero_ref or neg_negzero_got != 0 or neg_mism > 0}))
", "expected_signal": "outputs 0x8000 or wrong bits for -0 input / extreme negatives confirm c3; 0x3800 for both zeros and 0x0000 only for extreme negatives rebut"}
